units.source_text: 次年正月，禁中举行男踏歌会。

en.t: In the first month of the following year, a men's singing-and-dancing ceremony was held in the palace.

units.source_text: 当时殿上诸青年中，擅长音乐者甚多。

en.t: At that time, among the young courtiers serving at court, there were many who excelled at music.

units.source_text: 选择其中优秀者为踏歌人，命四位侍从薰君当右方的领唱。

en.t: The most accomplished of them were chosen as performers, and Kaoru, a fourth-rank chamberlain, was appointed to lead the singers on the right side.

units.source_text: 那位藏人少将也参加了乐队。

en.t: That Kuroudo no Shoushou also joined the musical ensemble.

units.source_text: 十四夜的月亮清光皎洁，天空了无纤云。

en.t: The moon on the fourteenth night shone with clear, bright light, and there was not the slightest wisp of cloud in the sky.

units.source_text: 男踏歌人从宫中退出，即赴冷泉院。

en.t: After leaving the palace, the male performers immediately went to Reizei-in.

units.source_text: 弘徽殿女御和这位新皇妃也在冷泉上皇近旁设席奉陪。

en.t: The Kokiden consort and the new imperial consort also had seats arranged near the Retired Emperor Reizei and attended upon him.

units.source_text: 公卿及诸亲王联袂偕来。

en.t: The court nobles and the various princes came together in company.

units.source_text: 在这时代，除了夕雾右大臣家族和已故致仕太政大臣家族之外，更无光彩辉煌的人物了。

en.t: In that age, apart from the family of Yugiri, the Minister of the Right, and the family of the late retired Grand Minister, there were no more brilliant figures.

units.source_text: 男踏歌人都认为冷泉院比宫中更富有情趣，因此表演得特别起劲。

en.t: The male performers all felt that Reizei-in had more charm than the palace, and so they performed with special enthusiasm.

units.source_text: 就中藏人少将猜想新皇妃必在帘内观赏，心情异常激动。

en.t: Among them, Kuroudo no Shoushou imagined that the new imperial consort must be watching from behind the blinds, and his heart was extraordinarily stirred.

units.source_text: 踏歌人头上插着并无香色的绵制假花，却因人品而各有趣致。

en.t: The performers wore artificial cotton flowers in their hair, flowers without scent or color, yet each gained its own charm from the man who wore it.

units.source_text: 歌声舞态无不尽善尽美。

en.t: Their singing voices and dancing forms were all as perfect and beautiful as could be.

units.source_text: 藏人少将回思去年春夜唱着《竹河》舞近阶前时的情状，不禁伤心流泪，几乎舞错了动作。

en.t: Kuroudo no Shoushou remembered the scene on that spring night the previous year, when he had sung Takekawa and danced close to the steps, and he could not help shedding sorrowful tears, almost missing a movement in the dance.

units.source_text: 踏歌人由此转赴秋好皇后宫中，冷泉院也到皇后宫中来观赏。

en.t: From there the performers moved on to the palace of Empress Akikonomu, and Reizei-in also came to the empress's palace to watch.
The deeper the night grew, the brighter the moonlight became.

units.source_text: 皓月当空，比白昼更为明亮。

en.t: The bright moon hung high in the sky, making it seem even brighter than daylight.

units.source_text: 藏人少将推想此时新皇妃不知如何看他，便觉全身飘忽，似乎足不着地。

en.t: Kuroudo no Shoushou wondered how the new imperial consort might be looking at him now, and felt his whole body grow light and unsteady, as if his feet no longer touched the ground.

units.source_text: 观众向踏歌人敬酒，好像专在敬他一人，实在不好意思。

en.t: When the spectators offered wine to the performers, it seemed as though they were honoring him alone, and he felt truly embarrassed.
